audit.method: Every item verified against actual code, migrations, and tests in this repository. No status was taken from documentation alone. The offline test suite (285 assertions), strict typecheck, and production build were executed during this audit; the live deployment was probed over HTTP.

verification.live_probe: https://sophira.vercel.app: / -> 307 /login, /login 200, /install 200, /downloads 200, /manifest.webmanifest 200, /api/health 200 — production is in the documented DEGRADED mode (no Supabase/AI env configured)
verification.not_fabricated: No live Supabase/AI/search-provider run was possible in this audit environment (no credentials); those items are marked below accordingly.

items.title: Claim-to-source evidence verification with full trace (CLAIM → SOURCE → PASSAGE → URL → STATUS)
items.notes: Added 2026-10-05 on top of the existing research stack (nothing deleted or replaced). Extraction stage after retrieval and before final essay generation; per-claim storage of claim_id, assignment_id, claim_text, source_id, source_url, source_title, exact_supporting_passage, evidence_start/end, verification_status, confidence, authority_score, verified_at; mechanical verification (verbatim passage in stored content + figure consistency + overlap) — a claim is VERIFIED only when the retrieved content actually supports it; unsupported claims are explicitly marked and the essay generator is BLOCKED from declaring research complete; final Research Integrity report with counts and FAILED (claim, reason, action) blocks; source-unavailable-after-verification demotes claims to UNVERIFIED at audit time.
tests_existing: 41 assertions in tests/run.ts section 16b: valid match, valid-URL-unsupported-claim, dead URL, wrong source, unrelated source, partial support, multi-source, multi-claim, unsupported, source-unavailable-after-verification, fabricated passage, numeric mismatch, authority, report formatting
tests_missing: Live end-to-end run with a configured AI + search provider (external credentials)
env: SEARCH_API_KEY (live retrieval — mechanical verification itself is offline)
blockers: Live verification needs AI + search credentials (external)
